name: ghcli-01b
license_note: LICENSE re-read live at the fix commit before vendoring: MIT
instruction: In package pkg/cmd/issue/artifact/shared (results.go), add an exported function with this exact signature: func PrintUnchanged(ios *iostreams.IOStreams, r Result, message, reason string). It prints the line for an artifact the command did not change because it already was as asked. When stdout is not a terminal, it writes one piped result line on stdout with status "skipped", the artifact Number and Name columns, and the reason, in the same shared column format as PrintSuccess/PrintSkip/PrintFailure ("skipped\t<Number>\t<Name>\t\t<reason>"). When stdout is a terminal, stdout stays empty and it writes "! <message>" on stderr using the color scheme's warning icon (yellow "!" when color is enabled). It is not a failure: the command still exits 0.
supersedes: ghcli-01 (instruction underspecified the required signature; 9/9 rows failed, excluded per holdout/LABELS.tsv)
